summary: Titania Holding AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, and management of real estate properties in Sweden. It operates through Completed Projects, and Projects in Progress segment. The company develops and leases housing and condominiums; operates as a general contractor; owns and manages investment properties; and builds and sells developed properties. It also provides land acquisition; project management, procurement of subcontracts, monitoring of construction, and ongoing dialogue with subcontractors; and property maintenance, technical management, financial management, and leasing services. Titania Holding AB (publ) was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
